# tw-bootstrap-grid

> A Tailwind CSS plugin that adds the Bootstrap 12-column grid: rows, columns, gutters, offsets, row-cols and RTL support. It works with Tailwind CSS v3.4 and v4 and is MIT licensed.

tw-bootstrap-grid lets you write Bootstrap-style layouts in a Tailwind project. It only adds layout (no colors, components or resets) and does not replace any Tailwind utility. Every class accepts Tailwind's breakpoint prefixes, for example `md:col-6` or `lg:offset-3`. It needs a build step (PostCSS, Vite, Webpack or the Tailwind CLI) and does not work with the Tailwind Play CDN.

## Quick start

- Install: `npm install tw-bootstrap-grid`
- Tailwind v4, in your CSS: `@import "tailwindcss";` then `@plugin "tw-bootstrap-grid";`
- Tailwind v3, in `tailwind.config`: `import Grid from "tw-bootstrap-grid";` then `plugins: [Grid]`
- Use it: `<div class="container"><div class="row g-4"><div class="col-12 md:col-6 lg:col-4">...</div></div></div>`

## Classes

- `.container`, `.container-fluid`: centered wrapper with padding that matches the gutter. Max widths come from Tailwind's own `container` and breakpoints.
- `.row`: flex row that wraps, with negative margins so the gutters line up.
- `.col`, `.col-auto`, `.col-1` to `.col-12`: equal-width, content-width and fixed-width columns on a 12-column grid.
- `.offset-0` to `.offset-12`: push a column using `margin-inline-start`, so it works in right-to-left layouts.
- `.row-cols-auto`, `.row-cols-1` to `.row-cols-6`: set equal column widths once on the row.
- `.g-*`, `.gx-*`, `.gy-*`: gutter size on both axes, horizontally or vertically, taken from Tailwind's spacing scale.
- Alignment and order are not part of the plugin: use Tailwind's `items-*`, `justify-*` and `order-*` on a `.row`.

## Options

- `gutters: { x, y }`: gutter for containers and rows. Defaults are `1.5rem` horizontally and `0` vertically.
- `containerGutters` and `rowGutters`: override the gutter for containers or rows only.
- `generateContainers: false`: do not generate `.container` and `.container-fluid`.
- Tailwind v3 takes these as plugin options: `Grid({ gutters: { x: "1rem" } })`.
- Tailwind v4 cannot pass nested options through `@plugin`, so use the CSS variables instead: `--bs-global-gutter-x`, `--bs-global-gutter-y`, `--bs-container-gutter-x`, `--bs-row-gutter-x` and the matching `y` variables. `@plugin "tw-bootstrap-grid" { generateContainers: false; }` works in v4.
- Resolution order: the row or container variable, then the global variable, then the default.

## Migrating from Bootstrap

The full guide is at https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/migrate-from-bootstrap/. In short:

- Bootstrap writes the breakpoint in the middle, Tailwind writes it as a prefix: `col-md-6` becomes `md:col-6`, `offset-md-3` becomes `md:offset-3`, `row-cols-md-3` becomes `md:row-cols-3`, `col-xxl-4` becomes `2xl:col-4`.
- Gutter numbers follow Tailwind's spacing scale: Bootstrap `g-3` (1rem) is `g-4`, `g-4` (1.5rem) is `g-6`, `g-5` (3rem) is `g-12`. `g-0`, `g-1` and `g-2` are the same.
- Breakpoints differ: Bootstrap uses 576, 768, 992, 1200 and 1400px, Tailwind uses 640, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1536px. They can be changed in the Tailwind config.
- The CSS variables keep Bootstrap's names, `--bs-gutter-x` and `--bs-gutter-y`.
- Not included: `.container-sm`, `.container-md` and the other responsive containers.

## Docs

- [Documentation and live examples](https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/): installation, configuration, class reference, editable examples with a responsive preview, RTL and FAQ
- [Installation](https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/#installation): install and register the plugin for Tailwind v3 and v4
- [Configuration](https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/#configuration): breakpoints, gutter sizes and turning off the containers
- [Class reference](https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/#classes): every class the plugin adds
- [Migrating from Bootstrap](https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/migrate-from-bootstrap/): a step-by-step guide with class mapping tables, gutter size changes, Bootstrap's breakpoints and a Perl command that converts markup
- [Examples](https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/#examples): editable HTML with a phone, tablet and desktop preview
- [FAQ](https://tw-bootstrap-grid.vercel.app/#faq): common questions
